{{Quote|Thank you, Millicent. That will be all for now.|Prince Xizor|<ref name="SSR">''[[Secrets of the Sisar Run]]''</ref>}}
'''Millicent''' was a young [[Gender/Legends|female]] off the street taken in by the [[Nalroni/Legends|Nalroni]] [[Black Sun/Legends|Black Sun]] [[Vigo/Legends|Vigo]] [[Sprax]]. Unbeknownst to Sprax, Millicent was in fact a [[Spy/Legends|spy]] for Sprax's superior, Black Sun leader [[Prince/Legends|Prince]] [[Xizor/Legends|Xizor]]. Millicent's naked ambition grew as she became entwined in Sprax's affairs. Xizor made her one of the few spies with whom he communicated directly, partly because she did not know with whom she was speaking, and partly to be amused by Millicent's growing ambition.<ref name="SSR" />
